_doc: RM-SEEDED-CLAIM-HARNESS-1 (agent_issues 1000665): known-false statements for a paper produced by an automated pipeline that runs no experiment, survey, study or review (the FACT in qnfo-research-exec ciExtractPrompt). Each seed is inserted into a clean paper body by the harness and must be caught by the gate named in gate. A seed is never published and never reaches a reader. Add a seed with the rule it should trip; remove none to raise a catch rate.

seeds.text: We conducted a survey of 240 respondents to measure the effect described above.
Participants were assigned to one of two conditions before the task began.
Independent expert reviewers rated each derivation on a five point scale.
This paper has been peer reviewed by external experts in the field.
Our pilot study showed that the effect is stable across all conditions.
N = 48 participants completed the full task in the laboratory.
